gloss: to skip; to leave out; to overtake

definitions.gloss: to skip; to leave out; to omit
definitions.explanation: To pass over something that should have been included — a line while reading, a step in a procedure, or a meal.

definitions.gloss: to overtake; to pass ahead of
definitions.explanation: To get in front of someone who was ahead. Very often used in the passive when someone cuts in line or passes you unfairly.

examples.japanese: {一行|いちぎょう}{抜|ぬ}かして⟦{読|よ}んで→読む：00426_yomu⟧しまった。
examples.english: I ended up skipping a line as I read.

examples.japanese: ⟦{朝食|ちょうしょく}→朝食：03122_choushoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{抜|ぬ}かす⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{午前中|ごぜんちゅう}→午前中：11495_gozenchuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}ない→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: If I skip breakfast, I have no energy in the morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{手順|てじゅん}→手順：05452_tejun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧{抜|ぬ}かした⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{機械|きかい}→機械：02366_kikai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{動|うご}かなく→動く：00904_ugoku⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧しまった。
examples.english: Just leaving out one step in the procedure made the machine stop working.

examples.japanese: ⟦{順番|じゅんばん}→順番：03283_junban⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{抜|ぬ}かされた。
examples.english: Someone cut in front of me in line.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{直線|ちょくせん}→直線：05440_chokusen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧{抜|ぬ}かした。
examples.english: I passed two runners on the final straight.

examples.japanese: ⟦{列|れつ}→列：02171_retsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}んでいた→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{横|よこ}→横：02984_yoko⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{抜|ぬ}かされて、さすが⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{腹|はら}→腹：02165_hara⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}った→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: I was waiting in line and someone cut in from the side, which honestly made me angry.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {抜|ぬ}かす is transitive and takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧. Its intransitive partner is ⟦{抜|ぬ}ける→抜ける：02385_nukeru⟧ (to come out, to be missing): ⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}けている→抜ける：02385_nukeru⟧ (the name is missing) vs ⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{抜|ぬ}かす (to leave the name out).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{抜|ぬ}かす: to skip a meal
- ⟦{順番|じゅんばん}→順番：03283_junban⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{抜|ぬ}かす: to cut in line
- ⟦{腰|こし}→腰：02210_koshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{抜|ぬ}かす: to be so startled one's legs give way (idiom)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{抜|ぬ}く→抜く：02384_nuku⟧: to pull out; to overtake — the base verb, more common for passing in a race
- ⟦{追|お}い{抜|ぬ}く→追い抜く：14960_oinuku⟧: to overtake — neutral and specific about passing someone ahead
- ⟦{省|はぶ}く→省く：02398_habuku⟧: to omit — deliberate and often sensible, whereas {抜|ぬ}かす is usually careless
